title: Preserve active audit state in close readiness
summary: Preserve current snapshot audit activity when reducing backend close-readiness state.
reason: Remediate P1 AUDIT-FIND-W03-015. The existing bundled-runtime regression returns safe_to_close=true for audit_progress.status=running when pipeline progress is empty.
behavior_before: The combined state reducer can classify an authoritative running-audit snapshot as idle when pipeline progress is empty and audit progress has no embedded timestamp.
behavior_after: Current active audit evidence will produce the audit state before non-blocking pipeline states, while explicitly timestamped stale audit evidence remains non-blocking.
